status: M10 electrical screen: M9 RO40 and pack assumptions plus the GL40 hub motors at their 16 V drive limit; thermal path bounds are assumptions pending measurement
inverter_efficiency_basis: Separate engineering screen assumption, not a measured moteus efficiency; use actual motor shaft power, with physical belt losses already represented in the plant
phase_current_convention: Peak sinusoidal phase current gives copper=0.75*Rline-line*Iq^2; if catalog current is RMS, double copper
stator_capacity_basis: RO40: credit only the adopted 34 g stator at copper heat capacity, as in M9. GL40: the 55 g stator side of the CAD stator/rotor split (an assumption from the 107 g CubeMars total). Rotor, housing and chassis conduction are not credited.
thermal_path_basis: Unqualified range including winding-to-case contact plus natural cooling inside housing; report required path and temperatures, not a claimed thermal pass
catalog_insulation_class: RO40 F (155C); GL40 KV70 H (180C, CubeMars product page). The 125C winding limit is the class-F value with a 30C hot-spot margin and is applied to both, so it is conservative for the GL40 hubs (GL40 class corrected 17 October 2026, Grok parts check)
regen_basis: At full charge assume zero battery acceptance; gross negative mechanical work is a winding/dump upper bound. Net estimate subtracts simultaneous positive motor work, copper and 6W auxiliary load. M9 dump thermal and software flux-brake response remain unqualified
phase_to_phase_resistance_basis: Order: left thigh, left knee, right thigh, right knee RO40 (M9 value), then left and right GL40 KV70 (CubeMars 4.5 ohm)
